honest_verdict: Zoho Invoice is part of a massive business suite. If you use other Zoho products, the integration is seamless. If you want standalone invoicing on your own server without an ecosystem dependency, Billfold is simpler.
seo_title: Billfold vs Zoho Invoice — Self-hosted invoicing at $0.99/mo

Billfold generates and tracks invoices. For integrated payment processing, Zoho Invoice or FreshBooks with Stripe are more complete.

stockyard_tagline: Self-hosted reverse proxy and auth gateway
stockyard_pro_summary: Unlimited upstreams, users, per-route limits, IP allowlists

API key auth without an OAuth2 provider
Rate limiting and IP allowlists included
honest_verdict: Traefik Forward Auth is a lightweight auth middleware for teams already running Traefik with OAuth2/OIDC. If you have that stack, it is the natural choice. Gate is for teams that want auth + proxy in one binary without running Traefik or configuring an OAuth provider.
seo_title: Gate vs Traefik Forward Auth — All-in-one auth proxy
seo_description: Traefik Forward Auth needs Traefik + OAuth2 provider. Gate is one binary: proxy + auth + rate limiting. No external dependencies.

faq.q: Is Gate a Traefik Forward Auth alternative?
faq.a: Traefik Forward Auth is middleware for Traefik. Gate is a standalone proxy with auth built in — no Traefik or OAuth provider needed.
Gate is its own reverse proxy. You would use Gate instead of Traefik, not alongside it.

seo_description: Infisical requires Docker, Postgres, and Redis. Strongbox is one binary. $1.99/mo flat vs $6/user/mo. No per-seat pricing.

faq.a: No. Strongbox provides an HTTP API. For Kubernetes-native secret sync, Infisical or external-secrets operator are more integrated.
